title: Idealized window-limited throughput at 40 ms RTT
method: Synthetic calculation using decimal MB and Mbit: throughput=window_bytes*8/0.040/1e6, capped at illustrative 1000 Mbit/s path. Ignores overhead, congestion, loss and endpoint limits; not a benchmark.
alt: Idealized window-limited throughput at 40 ms RTT. Illustrative values: 1 MB window 200 Mbit/s, 3 MB window 600 Mbit/s, 5 MB window 1000 Mbit/s.
